complexity.notes: The ALL-CAPS name for a local table reads like a constant; dp or paths is more idiomatic. Space can drop to O(min(m,n)) by keeping only ||one row of the table at a time||, and there is a closed-form ||binomial-coefficient formula, C(m+n-2, m-1)||, that reaches O(min(m,n)) time with O(1) space. `0 in [i, j]` is a cute way to test the border but allocates a two-element list each cell; `i == 0 or j == 0` is clearer.
complexity.summary: Bottom-up DP over an n-by-m table: first row and column are 1, every other cell is the sum of the cell above and the cell to its left, and the bottom-right cell holds the answer.
